## Checklist

- [ ] One story, at most about 600 changed lines (excluding tests and generated files)
- [ ] Tests assert the behaviour in the acceptance criteria
- [ ] Docs updated (spec, ADR, contracts, glossary) if behaviour or structure changed
- [ ] No secrets and no real personal data
